expectations.evidence: '+5V DC regulated — direct to all digital logic'
'9V AC — rectified on-board'; AC inherently unregulated

expectations.text: The classic failure is the 5V regulator failing such that the 5V rail rises (overvoltage)
expectations.evidence: 'brick's internal 5V regulator drifts high as it ages...overvolted 5V'

expectations.text: The overvoltage damages chips (RAM and/or other ICs)
expectations.evidence: 'fries RAM, PLA (U17), and other chips at once'
